about.title: Your business, your platform.
about.desc: Runbits is the digital commerce platform for local businesses. We give you the tools to sell online — with your brand, your customers, and 100% of your revenue.
about.whyP1: Local businesses deserve to sell online without giving up control of their business. We created Runbits so that any entrepreneur or merchant can have their own digital store, receive orders, and grow — independently, without sales commissions, and with direct access to their own customers.
about.whyP2: We believe the relationship between a business and its customers belongs to the business, not to a third-party platform. Every data point, every order, every interaction belongs to the business that worked to earn it.
about.howDesc: Sign up, set up your store in minutes, and start receiving orders. That simple.

step1.title: Sign up for free.
step1.desc: Create your account and choose your business type — products, services, or both. No credit card required.

step2.title: Set up your store.
step2.desc: Upload your catalog with photos and prices, customize colors and logo, and define your delivery and payment methods.

step3.title: Receive orders.
step3.desc: Your customers buy from your store. You manage everything from the dashboard — orders, stock, analytics, and more.

step4.title: Grow without limits.
step4.desc: Activate additional modules as you need them — push notifications, WhatsApp bot, GPS tracking, and more.

value1.title: Transparency.
value1.desc: Clear pricing, no surprises. You know exactly what you pay each month.

value2.title: Independence.
value2.desc: Your store, your brand, your customers. We never share your information with other businesses.

value3.title: No commissions.
value3.desc: Pay a flat monthly fee and keep 100% of every sale.

value4.title: Your customers are yours.
value4.desc: Access your database, export it, and take it with you if you ever decide to migrate. No lock-in.

value5.title: Multi-vertical.
value5.desc: Not just food delivery. Services, products, bookings — the platform adapts to your business.

about.companyP1: Runbits is developed by Runbits.io LLC, a company registered in Wyoming, United States. It was born with a focus on Latin American businesses — businesses that want to grow in the digital world without giving up control of what they built.
about.companyP2: We are committed to building a fair, accessible platform designed from day one so that the success of each business is our success.

security.heroSubtitle: We protect your account, your data, and your customers' data with the same security practices banks use. No compromises.
security.gridSubtitle: Every Runbits account is covered by these measures — always on, no configuration required.

2fa.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
2fa.desc: TOTP via apps like Google Authenticator. 10 single-use backup codes included.

passkeys.title: Passkeys (FIDO2)
passkeys.desc: Passwordless sign-in with biometrics — phishing-resistant by design.

aes.title: AES-256-GCM
aes.desc: Your 2FA secrets are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM and HKDF derivation.

pbkdf2.title: PBKDF2 600,000 iterations
pbkdf2.desc: Passwords hashed with PBKDF2-SHA256 at 600k iters — beyond the OWASP standard.

hibp.title: Breached-password detection
hibp.desc: Checked against HIBP (k-anonymity) — passwords seen in breaches are rejected.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.desc: Every sensitive action is logged with IP, user agent, and timestamp.

sessions.title: Session management
sessions.desc: See your active sessions per device and revoke them individually.

jwtRotation.title: JWT key rotation
jwtRotation.desc: KID-aware JWT headers — we can rotate the signing key without breaking active tokens.

https.title: HTTPS + HSTS
https.desc: TLS enforced everywhere. HSTS with includeSubDomains on every response.

rateLimit.title: Rate limiting
rateLimit.desc: Strict per-IP and per-email limits on login, register, and password reset.

oauthCsrf.title: OAuth CSRF protection
oauthCsrf.desc: One-shot KV-bound state tokens on every OAuth flow (Google, Facebook).

encryptionAtRest.title: Encryption at rest
encryptionAtRest.desc: Our entire D1 database is encrypted at rest across Cloudflare's network.

security.complianceSubtitle: We meet the data-protection standards relevant to your business.

gdpr.title: GDPR + Argentina Law 25.326
gdpr.desc: We comply with the EU General Data Protection Regulation and Argentina's Personal Data Protection Law.

soc2.title: SOC 2 Type II
soc2.desc: SOC 2 audit in progress. Certification expected during 2026.

security.reportDesc: Found a security issue? Email us directly. We respond within 24 hours and publicly credit anyone who helps us protect the platform.
security.reportFootnote: PGP key available on request. Please don't disclose publicly until we've confirmed a fix.

details.title: Security technical details
details.subtitle: Open documentation of how we protect your account and your data.
details.authDesc: We support multiple authentication methods, all with optional second factor:

auth.password: Email + password with PBKDF2-SHA256 at 600,000 iterations
auth.totp: TOTP RFC 6238 (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password) with 10 single-use backup codes
auth.passkeys: WebAuthn / FIDO2 passkeys with biometrics — TOTP automatically bypassed because of their phishing-resistant nature
auth.oauth: Google, Apple Sign In, and Facebook Login (with cryptographic token verification)

details.cryptoDesc: JWTs are signed with HMAC-SHA256 and support key rotation (KID in the header). TOTP secrets are encrypted with AES-256-GCM derived via HKDF, separated from the JWT key. Passwords are hashed with PBKDF2-SHA256 at 600,000 iterations — twice the OWASP 2023 recommendation.
details.sessionsDesc: Each refresh token is bound to a device fingerprint (IP + User-Agent). Tokens rotate on every use (single-use rotation). We maintain a per-user index so you can list and revoke active sessions individually or all at once.
details.auditDesc: Logged actions: login, logout, password change, 2FA enable/disable, backup code regeneration, passkey add/revoke, admin account modification, impersonation. Each entry includes IP, user agent, timestamp, and action-specific metadata.
details.responseDesc: If we detect an incident affecting your account, we email you within 72 hours and publish a postmortem within 30 days. Mass session reset available via support.
